text.description: the text on the face; line breaks start new lines

font.description: font of the text (Shared/Fonts/ZCOOLQingKeHuangYou from @stride-ts/assets has Chinese); content path of a font asset (no extension)

size.description: width, height, depth (floor stickers: width and length, the length along the top of the texture); unit: m

style.description: lightbox: the face glows (lit from inside); panel: it does not; floor: a floor sticker, only a transparent SVG of the same name, put on the floor with a decal; banner: a promo flag hanging from the ceiling (printed on both sides, a rod and two cords on top); stand: a price card on a pole with a round base by a floor stack (origin on the floor)

hang.description: length of the cords of a banner (m)

standHeight.description: height from the floor to the top of a stand card (m)

shape.description: floor sticker shape: rounded rectangle, round badge, arrow (pointing to the top of the texture; turn the entity to aim it)

wear.description: how worn a floor sticker is (0..1): scratches and scuffed patches from the seed

doubleSided.description: a face on the back too (signs hanging over an aisle)

frame.description: frame color (sRGB #rrggbb, brushed grey when missing; the outline of a floor sticker, white when missing)

colors.description: colors of the face, the text and the frame

brightness.description: emissive strength of a lightbox face
